name: @yottameta/yotta-anti-shallow
description: Anti-shallow AI output rules engine: force analyze-first / execute-after / self-check, curbing superficial output. Activates on intent for deep analysis, end-to-end verification, root-cause tracing, rigorous execution, meticulous checking; also applies automatically to any task at L3 (complex) and above. Boundaries: quality discipline only; no code execution, no external tools, not a replacement for tests or human review.
